          Enumeration Type Documentation
        

        

          

            enum ascii_color_t
          

          

            Shared terminal-cell contract for every ISA and scalar fallback.
            Palettes use complete UTF-8 glyphs from cache64. Runs never cross
            rows. Background mode sets a contrasting foreground. Colored rows
            finish with SGR reset before newline; monochrome rows carry no SGR
            or erase sequences. The returned buffer is owned by the caller and
            freed with SAFE_FREE. ISA entry points select their vector stages;
            callers must check CPU support.
